description: Conformance vectors for the Markspace plugin protocol in docs/plugins.md. sdk and sdk/python/markspace both load this file in their tests and must pass every case. The Markspace plugin host signs with sdk.

signature.key: The HMAC key is the 32 bytes decoded from the base64 signingSecret. MARKSPACE_SIGNING_SECRET holds the same base64 text.
signature.message: The decimal timestamp, the HTTP method, the request path without the query, and the delivery id, each followed by one newline (0x0A), then the raw body bytes. The method is used as sent. The path is the path of the request line as sent, with percent-encoding kept.
signature.grammar: The header is exactly t=<unix seconds>,v1=<digest>. The timestamp is ASCII decimal from 1 to 9223372036854775807 with no sign and no leading zero. The digest is 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other text, whitespace, order or extra part is malformed.
signature.window: A request is expired when the absolute difference between now and t, both in whole seconds, exceeds windowSeconds. A difference of exactly windowSeconds is accepted.
signature.replay: After a request passes the signature and time checks, the receiver rejects it as a replay when it has already accepted the same delivery id with the same timestamp within the window. Markspace signs every attempt with a fresh timestamp, so a retry of one delivery passes. Rejected requests are not recorded. The cache is a bounded LRU, 10000 entries by default.

verify.name: valid at window edge in the past
valid at window edge in the future
wrong secret and expired reports mismatch
delivery id moved into the body
empty delivery id signed as empty

requests.note: the same header under another delivery id fails the HMAC
retry of d1 signed at a new timestamp
another delivery with the same body and timestamp
d1 at its first timestamp with another body
d2 at the same timestamp on another path
d4 with a good signature after a rejected attempt
old replay outside the window is expired

pluginId.use: manifest id, the X-Markspace-Plugin header, the first segment of a qualified id

localId.use: command, panel, action, importer and form ids and job kinds, as declared in the manifest and used in plugin URL paths

qualifiedId.use: <pluginId>.<localId>, as in openPanel.id. The plugin id ends at the first dot

objectId.use: job, item, space, user and delivery ids in host API paths. core.NewID values match

storageKey.use: kv and blob keys. 1 to 512 bytes of UTF-8 with no control characters (U+0000 to U+001F and U+007F). Clients percent-encode every byte outside A-Z a-z 0-9 - . _ ~ in the path

eventPattern.use: @on and p.On patterns. * matches any run of characters, dots included. No other character is special

rules: Checks run in three passes and report the first error only. Each invalid case below contains exactly one error.
Pass 1 checks size. Size is the compact JSON encoding in UTF-8 with no HTML escaping. A size above maxBytes is too_large at the root path.

Pass 2 checks limits. It visits every JSON object in the tree in pre-order, with object keys in ascending byte order and array elements in index order. Every object counts 1 toward maxNodes, including form fields, options, columns, list items, badges, table rows, action objects, link targets, payload objects and objects nested in payloads. The depth of an object is the number of objects on the path from the root to it, both included. Arrays add no depth. At each object the pass reports too_deep when the depth exceeds maxDepth, then too_many_nodes when the count exceeds maxNodes, at the path of that object.

Pass 3 walks the structure depth-first. At each UI node, form field, list item and table row it checks not_object, then type for UI nodes, then unknown fields in ascending byte order of the name, then each declared field in the order of fieldOrder. Nested values are checked when their field is reached. Payload contents are not checked.

UI nodes, form fields, list items and table rows report not_object when the value is not a JSON object. Any other value of the wrong JSON type reports invalid_field. That includes an action, link target, option, column or list item badge that is not an object.

A slot limited to button nodes reports unknown_type for a missing or unknown type and invalid_field for another known node type. List item actions, table rowActions and empty.action are button slots. The action of a button or form is an action object {id, payload}, and a form requires it.
A list item badge is an object with the badge fields label and tone, and an optional type that must be badge.
Table row values are strings, numbers, booleans or null.
Field values are strings, numbers, booleans or null. options is [{value, label}], required on select fields and not allowed on other field types. Field names are unique across fields and more.
Link urls use the http or https scheme, compared without case, have a host, and contain no whitespace or control characters. A link to has exactly one of itemId and url.

count is an integer of at least 0. progress value is a number of at least 0, max is a number above 0, and value above max reports invalid_field at value after max is checked. Booleans are not numbers.
A link target reports invalid_field when it is not an object or does not hold exactly one of itemId and url, after its unknown keys are checked.

generators.wide: {type: stack, children: n copies of {type: text, value: "x"}}
generators.wideUnknown: {type: stack, children: n copies of {type: nope}}
generators.wideTable: {type: table, columns: [{key: "a", label: "A"}], rows: n copies of {a: 1}}
generators.buttons: {type: stack, children: n copies of {type: button, label: "b", action: {id: "a"}}}
generators.selectOptions: {type: form, id: "f", action: {id: "a"}, fields: [{type: select, name: "s", options: n copies of {value: "v", label: "V"}}]}
generators.deep: n nested stacks. The innermost has children []
generators.deepPayload: {type: button, label: "b", action: {id: "a", payload: P}}, where P is n nested objects {a: {a: ... {}}} and the innermost is {}
generators.bigText: {type: text, value: n copies of "a"}. The encoded size is n + 26 bytes

cases.name: unknown fields report the smallest name
payload objects are not validated beyond limits
list item action not a button
table column and rows count as nodes

rules: A command response is an object with exactly one of toast, openPanel, navigate, job and ui.
Check order is not_object, unknown keys in ascending byte order, empty_response, multiple_kinds, then the one kind.
toast is {message, kind}. message is a non-empty string. kind is info, success, warn or error, and defaults to info.
openPanel is {id, itemId}. id is a qualifiedId. itemId is an objectId.
navigate is a path inside Markspace of 1 to 2048 bytes. It starts with / and not with // or /\, and contains no control characters.
job is {id} with an objectId.
ui is a UI tree. Its error paths start at $.ui.
The body is an object. Unknown keys are ignored.
Checks run in the order pluginId, markspaceUrl, token, signingSecret, grants, permissions.
pluginId must equal the manifest id, else wrong_plugin.
markspaceUrl is an http or https URL with a host and no query or fragment, else invalid_url.
token is a non-empty string with no whitespace or control characters.
signingSecret is standard base64 with padding, matching ^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$, decoding to at least 32 bytes, else invalid_secret.
grants is an array of {spaceId, role} with role viewer, commenter or editor. permissions is an array of strings.
